Information Technology & Networking

Master SEO, social media, Google Ads, and analytics to plan, execute, and measure campaigns that drive real results. From concept to conversion — learn every step hands-on with guidance from industry mentors.

$200

Course Information

Level
Beginner
Lectures
32 Lectures
Duration
6 Months

About this course

This program helps you go beyond buzzwords. Learn digital marketing strategies, performance tools, and creative techniques that actually work in the real market.

You'll train through live campaigns, analytics dashboards, and ad simulations, gaining the confidence to plan and optimize marketing initiatives from day one.

Skill Haara delivers ISO 9001:2015 and 21001:2018–certified training with modern labs, expert mentors, and structured placement guidance across all Kerala branches.

Available in Trivandrum, Kochi (Aluva), and Thrissur

What you'll learn

Search Engine Optimization (SEO)

Learn how Google ranks pages, master on-page, off-page, and technical SEO to improve visibility.

Social Media Marketing

Create and manage campaigns for Facebook, Instagram, and LinkedIn that attract real engagement.

Google Ads & PPC

Understand campaign setup, bidding strategies, and ad copywriting to deliver measurable ROI.

Email & Content Marketing

Build audiences through storytelling, automation, and data-driven content planning.

Web Analytics (Google Analytics & Tag Manager)

Track, measure, and interpret performance with confidence.

Brand Strategy & Digital Planning

Connect creativity with data to build meaningful online presence.

How learning works here

  • Every concept moves from demo → guided lab → live project.
  • Mentors ensure clarity and progress through regular feedback, while small batches keep learning interactive.
  • By the end, you'll complete real campaigns and add measurable results to your portfolio.

Who this fits

  • Students after 12th or graduates who want a career in marketing, media, or content.
  • Entrepreneurs and freelancers seeking to grow their own brands or client base.
  • Working professionals ready to switch into digital-first roles without losing momentum.

Outcomes that matter

Confidently manage SEO, SEM, and social media campaigns. Build digital portfolios that showcase campaigns you've planned and executed. Graduate job-ready for roles like Digital Marketing Executive, SEO Analyst, Social Media Manager, or PPC Specialist.

Certifications we prepare for

Google Ads Certification
HubSpot Content Marketing
Meta (Facebook) Blueprint
Skill Haara Program Certificate — Our mentors also guide you through freelancing setup and interview preparation so your skills translate into real projects and job opportunities.
